notes: Mirrors grammar-replace-0009: the transitivity of 'is a constituent of' is removed, so neither instance can be concluded any more (new_answer null). Instance facts are stated in the prompt, so the derived queries ask what follows, not what is true (README, Determinacy: RBox). Locality references are the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. 'Is a constituent of' is the dominance relation of constituency grammar, which is transitive (a constituent of a constituent is a constituent); 'immediate constituent' would not be, so the prompts use the plain relation. Both instances are textbook bracketings: [[the old dog] barked], [she [read [a long book]]].
